title: Unit curriculum row (curriculum.csv)
description: One row of schedules/out/<study>/<unit>/curriculum.csv, read as an object of strings (e.g. csv.DictReader). The file has exactly 32 rows in planning order (family K then Q, action index, referent index) and the header: family, action_index, referent_index, message_id, components_available_wave, training_wave, B_first_novel_visit_default, A_novel_default, counterbalance, unit_id, semantic_action, semantic_referent, heldout_set, swap_w1_w4, seed, novel_visit. The first nine columns repeat planning curriculum.csv (counterbalance holds the unit's block ID); the format version is permutation.json format_version. See docs/interfaces/schedules.md.

components_available_wave.description: First wave at which both component atoms are introduced.

training_wave.description: Abstract matrix training wave; empty for held-out messages. Study A teaches all 18 trained messages on day 0.

B_first_novel_visit_default.description: Study B test visit before any W1/W4 swap; empty for trained messages.

A_novel_default.description: Study A use before any swap; empty for trained messages.

counterbalance.description: Block ID of the stored counterbalancing assignment.

novel_visit.description: Realised test visit of a held-out message for this unit, after the swap; empty for trained messages.
